title: Saving an edited role shows 'Role updated successfully.' after a confirmation dialog
custom_preconds: 1. You are editing an existing custom role.
custom_steps:
1. Change one or more permissions.
  2. Click Save.
  3. Confirm in the dialog.
custom_expected:
A confirmation dialog appears listing the added and removed permissions, with a 'don't show this again' option and Cancel/Confirm buttons.

After confirming, a green success message 'Role updated successfully.' appears and you return to the roles list.
viu_status: Blocked-UI behavior; 'Role updated successfully.' toast build-verified
evidence: Toast 'Role updated successfully.' confirmed in build (EditRole). Confirm-dialog flow needs live editor.
